title: Release ops Beta milestones and GitHub hygiene
summary: Completes GitHub release and milestone hygiene so every version in the Change Log Hub has a matching tag and Beta title, product milestones use the v0.N.x Beta naming convention, and agent docs match the enforced changelog-prepare workflow.
changes: Backfill six missing GitHub Releases so release history matches the Change Log Hub (141 tags).
Rename remaining historical release display titles to the {VERSION} Beta convention.
Extend migrate-beta-milestones.sh to rename product milestones #1–#9 with completed-line descriptions.
Document milestone migration in ship-gate and require --pr in the release-metadata skill table.
Clarify AGENTS.md that v0.31.x–v0.39.x Beta product lines are closed with no open backlog milestone.
affected_areas: Release ops scripts and agent documentation
version_rationale: Patch on the completed 0.39.x line: repository and GitHub hygiene only; no application feature changes.
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
Verified GitHub Releases count matches releases.json and milestone titles use v0.N.x Beta.
known_limitations: GitHub ops (backfill, title rename, milestone migrate) were applied directly on the repository before merge; rerunning scripts is idempotent.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Documentation and script changes do not alter runtime application behaviour.
provenance: Issues #182 and #177; pull request #330; closes remaining open repository issues after deploy.
